title: Answer: the public pages state no account of a self

statements.text: Matter As Machine states no account of a self. A person is treated as matter executing algorithms, with humans and civilization among the high-level, emergent algorithms, and the desires that feel like a person's own are ways biology directs behavior. What makes one self, or where one ends, is not addressed.
statements.scope: the public pages of matterasmachine.com. Its article on God, a personal Jesus and the afterlife is for paying readers and was not read

sources.quote: Evolution, humans, civilization - high level, emergent algorithms.
These desires feel like our own, but they are also ways our biology directs our behavior.
